title: Driver Response Contract
description: Unified JSON envelope every driver (private, lives under DRIVERS_ROOT) must emit. Script channel: this is the whole stdout payload; MCP channel: this is content[0].text. Exit code + this payload together form the contract, and both channels carry the same code inside error.code.

meta.description: Known keys are declared below. Drivers MAY add source-specific keys (health/detail/adapterPresent/...): consumers must ignore unknown keys rather than reject them, otherwise every new driver forces a contract revision.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS contract file; absent means 1

source.description: driver slot name or logical source: database | logs | tickets | efficiency | demo | menu | ...

project.description: identity.code the driver resolved its config by. Omitted only when args are so broken no code was known (exit 1/2 before routing).

truncated.description: true = hit --limit and cut; consumers must surface this in their final report

syncTs.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp taken by the driver at emit time

query.description: The statement ACTUALLY executed, placeholders kept as placeholders (bound values belong to `params`) - never a statement reconstructed after the fact. This is what lets a reviewer re-run the result instead of trusting it. Optional HERE on purpose: making it required would brick every driver registered before it existed, so enforcement lives one layer up - skills/data-fetch must surface an envelope that has neither `query` nor `queryOmitted` as `query_missing`.

params.description: Values bound to the placeholders in `query`, in the same order (array) or under the same names (object). Legal only next to `query`: parameters for a statement nobody showed are a second unexplained source of truth, not extra evidence.

queryOmitted.description: Why there is no `query` to show: fetch happened inside an adapter the shell cannot see | statement withheld because it carries credentials/sensitive business values (say what was redacted) | no statement exists at all (health probe, directory listing, file metadata). Mutually exclusive with `query`. Omitting BOTH keys is not a third legal state - it is the defect state the enum exists to make distinguishable.

data.description: Tabular shape is required when ok=true (see definitions/tabular); ok=false envelopes normally omit it.

error.description: Absent or null when ok=true; an object when ok=false. error.code IS the process exit code, which is what makes the MCP channel (no exit code) diagnosable.
